ma.setSwipeBack(Object object)

Sets whether to disable iOS gesture control.(minimum version: 26.3.0,effective only on iOS devices).

Note: This API is called by an H5 mini program to control whether sliding is supported globally, or called by a DSL mini program to control whether sliding is supported on the current page.

Parameter

Object object
Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
enableSwipeBack Boolean Yes Indicates Whether to disable sliding. Not disabled: false; Disabled: false.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String setSwipeBack: ok

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String setSwipeBack: fail, + error cause (null if no result is returned)

Sample Code

ma.setSwipeBack({
  enableSwipeBack: true,
  success: (res) => {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'setSwipeBack success',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  },
  fail: (res) => {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'setSwipeBack fail',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  },
  complete: (res) => {
    ma.showModal({
      title: 'setSwipeBack complete',
      content: JSON.stringify(res),
      showCancel: false
    })
  }
});
